faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: How ShopFinder finds, validates and delivers the best offers.

items.q: How does ShopFinder get better prices?
items.a: We aggregate offers from manufacturers, authorized distributors and marketplaces (eBay, AliExpress, Amazon, Newegg, DigiKey) into a single catalog. When you buy, the order is automatically forwarded to the supplier with the best price — you pay once and the rest is invisible.

items.q: What currency are prices shown in?
items.a: Prices are shown in BRL with an hourly-updated USD-BRL rate, so the value reflects the current exchange rate with no checkout surprises.

Each specification can carry its source (manufacturer, datasheet, distributor or marketplace) and a confidence level. Attributes with traced origin and evidence have high confidence; AI estimates show lower confidence and go through review.
The catalog keeps a graph of relations (e.g.: CPU and motherboard with the same socket). On the product page you can see what is compatible before buying, avoiding parts that do not work together.

sections.title: 1. Company identification
sections.body: ShopFinder is a shopping comparison and intermediation service operated by the legal entity and at the address identified in the company information section below. Official support channel: support email, with a response time of up to 2 business days.

sections.title: 2. Definitions and platform role
sections.body: ShopFinder is a price comparison and purchase intermediation platform. We are not the seller of the products: offers come from integrated third-party suppliers, and the contract of sale is formed between you and the supplier. Payments are processed by Stripe and shipping is the supplier's responsibility.

sections.title: 3. Marketplace role and third-party responsibility
sections.body: As a comparison/intermediation platform, ShopFinder does not manufacture, stock or ship the products. Quality, manufacturer warranty, delivery and after-sales support are obligations of the supplier responsible for the offer. Our role is to vet suppliers before integration (documentation and reputation), monitor complaints and facilitate contact and refunds. Nothing in these Terms waives or reduces consumer rights — including joint and several liability where established under applicable consumer law.

sections.title: 4. Eligibility and account
sections.body: Registration is available to individuals aged 18 or over. You agree to provide true, complete and up-to-date information, to keep your credentials secure (password and, when enabled, your 2FA code) and to notify us of unauthorized use of your account. By completing registration you declare that you have read and accepted these Terms and the Privacy Policy — electronic acceptance with full validity. The accepted version and date are recorded in your account.

sections.title: 5. Offers, advertising and information
sections.body: Displayed offers are the responsibility of the supplier who listed them. ShopFinder verifies and normalizes specifications but does not guarantee real-time price, stock or availability — confirm the information on the offer page before completing your purchase. BRL prices use live exchange-rate conversion and may vary.

sections.title: 6. Payments and security
sections.body: Payments are processed by Stripe. We do not store card data. We apply technical and organizational measures to protect data and transactions.

sections.title: 7. Refunds, cancellations and withdrawal
sections.body: Refunds are processed by the supplier responsible for the offer. To cancel or withdraw (where consumer protection law grants a withdrawal right — for example, 7 days from delivery, no justification and no cost), contact the supplier with your order number and copy us so we can mediate. If the supplier does not respond, we will intermediate the contact and refund. Refunded amounts include shipping when applicable.

sections.title: 8. Customer support
sections.body: Our support channel is the email indicated in section 1, with a response time of up to 2 business days. Complaints about delivery or product quality may also be directed to the responsible supplier.

sections.title: 9. Use of artificial intelligence
sections.body: ShopFinder uses AI tools to organize, summarize and recommend catalog products (search, comparison and reviews), based on product data and specifications — not on sensitive personal data. AI outputs are automated suggestions and do not constitute a warranty or advice. We do not make automated decisions with legal effect on you; human review can be requested through support.

sections.title: 10. Intellectual property, DMCA and takedown
sections.body: The ShopFinder brand, design and code belong to the platform operator; supplier and manufacturer names and trademarks belong to their owners. Copyright holders may report violations via the support email, providing: identification of the work, the URL of the allegedly infringing content, contact information and a good-faith statement. Infringing content is removed within a reasonable time, and the responsible party may submit a counter-notice.

sections.title: 11. Supplier terms
sections.body: Suppliers join the platform by accepting their own terms. Supplier obligations include: accuracy of specifications, prices, stock and delivery times; fulfillment, warranty and complaint handling. ShopFinder may suspend or remove suppliers in case of fraud, recurring complaints or breach. The current model does not charge a sales commission.

sections.title: 12. Responsibilities and limitation
sections.body: We are responsible for correctly displaying offer information and for the platform's operation, without prejudice to rights granted by applicable law. Because sales contracts are formed between you and the supplier, claims about delivery or product quality must be addressed to the supplier; we will facilitate contact and refunds when applicable. You agree to indemnify ShopFinder against claims arising from your violation of these Terms or misuse of the platform.

sections.title: 13. Suspension and termination
sections.body: We may suspend or terminate accounts used in violation of these Terms, with prior notice where possible. You may close your account at any time through the support channel.

sections.title: 14. Dispute resolution and arbitration
sections.body: Disputes are resolved first through our support channel and, where necessary, through the applicable consumer protection channels. Consumers domiciled in Brazil are NOT required to submit disputes to arbitration (art. 4, § 1, of Law 9.307/96). For US business accounts, disputes may be submitted to binding arbitration under the rules of the American Arbitration Association (AAA), with a class action waiver where permitted — without prejudice to non-waivable consumer rights.

sections.title: 15. Changes to these Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms; the current version and effective date appear at the top of this page. Material changes will be announced on the site in advance; continued use after notice constitutes acceptance of the new version.

sections.title: 16. Governing law and forum
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, USA, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Disputes shall be resolved in the courts of that state, except where the consumer protection laws of your place of residence grant you a different forum. If any provision is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in force (severability).

sections.title: 1. Controller and contact (DPO)
sections.body: The controller of your personal data is the ShopFinder platform operator. Our Data Protection Officer (DPO) can be reached at the support email indicated in the Contact section.

sections.title: 2. Categories of personal information we collect
sections.body: We collect only what is necessary to operate the platform, by category:

rows: items, quantities, amounts, status, shipping address you provide
access logs required to operate and secure the platform

sections.title: 3. How we use information and legal bases
sections.body: We use your data as described below. You may withdraw consent at any time through the support channel, without affecting prior processing.

rows: Display BRL prices and language preferences
Security, fraud prevention and legal compliance

sections.title: 4. Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use local storage (localStorage) and strictly functional cookies. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. The complete list, with duration and providers, is in our Cookie Policy (/cookies).

sections.title: 5. Sharing of data
sections.body: We share data only with: Stripe (payments), integrated suppliers (only what is needed to fulfill your order) and authorities when legally required.

sections.title: 6. International data transfer (art. 33 of the LGPD)
sections.body: Processing may occur outside Brazil by the following providers: Stripe, Inc. (US — payments), cloud and edge hosting providers (Vercel Inc. — US), Neon (database) and OpenAI (AI catalog evaluation, with no sensitive personal data). In these cases we follow art. 33 of the LGPD with standard contractual clauses, compliance guarantees (such as Stripe's PCI-DSS and certifications) and transfer limited to what is necessary.

sections.title: 7. Retention
sections.body: We keep account data while the account is active and order records for as long as necessary to meet legal obligations and defend legal claims, deleted afterwards.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.body: We apply technical (hashed passwords, TLS, access control, audit logs) and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access and accidental loss.

sections.title: 9. Security incidents (art. 48 of the LGPD)
sections.body: In the event of a security incident that may create relevant risk to you, we will notify the ANPD (Brazilian DPA) and affected data subjects within a reasonable time, describing the nature of the incident, the affected data, the risks and the mitigation measures. The channel to report incidents is our support email.

sections.title: 10. Use of artificial intelligence
sections.body: We use AI to enrich, summarize and recommend catalog products (search, comparison and reviews), using product data and specifications — not sensitive personal data. We do not make automated decisions with legal effect on you; human review is guaranteed through the support channel.

sections.title: 11. Your rights
sections.body: Depending on your jurisdiction you have the right to know, access, correct, delete and port your personal information, and to opt out of its sale or sharing — we do not sell it; you also have the right to non-discrimination for exercising these rights. To submit a request, email our Data Protection Officer — we respond within 15 days (LGPD) or 45 days (CCPA/CPRA) as applicable. The platform does not respond to Do Not Track browser signals; we do not track you across third-party sites.

sections.title: 12. Children
sections.body: The platform is not directed to children (under 13 under COPPA; under 18 for account creation under these Terms) and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

sections.title: 13. Changes to this policy
sections.body: The current version and effective date appear at the top of this page. Material changes will be announced on the site.

ShopFinder uses ONLY essential and preference storage: no analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

cookies.firefox: Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
cookies.safari: Safari: Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data
